name: informer
setup: python -c "import urllib.request, os; os.makedirs('data/ETT', exist_ok=True); d = urllib.request.urlopen('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhouhaoyi/ETDataset/main/ETT-small/ETTh2.csv', timeout=300).read(); open('data/ETT/ETTh2.csv', 'wb').write(d); print('ETTh2.csv', len(d))" && head -2 data/ETT/ETTh2.csv && wc -l data/ETT/ETTh2.csv
smoke: T0=$(date +%s); mkdir -p out; S=$(( $(printf %s "$RUN_TAG" | cksum | cut -d" " -f1) % 100000 )); B=""; [ "True" = False ] && B="$B --distil"; [ "True" = False ] && B="$B --mix"; [ "False" = True ] && B="$B --inverse"; GF_SEED=$S PYTHONPATH="/work${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}" python -u gf_harness/run.py --model informer --data ETTh2 --features M --pred_len 24 --root_path /work/data/ETT/ --checkpoints /work/out/checkpoints/ --itr 1 --des Exp --num_workers 0 --freq h --seq_len 48 --label_len 48 --d_model 512 --n_heads 8 --e_layers 2 --d_layers 1 --s_layers 3,2,1 --d_ff 2048 --factor 5 --padding 0 --dropout 0.05 --attn prob --embed timeF --activation gelu --train_epochs 6 --batch_size 32 --patience 3 --learning_rate 0.0001 --lradj type1 $B > out/run.log 2>&1; echo wall_s=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 )); grep -a 'Epoch: .* cost time\|Early stopping\|^mse' out/run.log; bash gf_harness/emit.sh
